content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (MINCOMMIT), fallback-level cure.**

- **Responsive locations inspected:** Para 7.1/7.2 (fixed Schedule B share of Capital and O&M Costs), Para 7.3–7.11 (billing, 300% extended payment charges), Para 12.2 (capacity in return for investment), Para 13.2/14.1 (no forced upgrade funding — helpful to us), Para 18.1–18.7 (25-year Initial Period, exit only at/after its end; no capital-cost credit), Para 22 (assignment only with Management Committee consent), Para 23.1–23.2 (capacity reclamation with no payment, credit or reimbursement).
- **Why deviation:** the cost-share obligation is effectively a 25-year take-or-pay with no unilateral reduction and no mid-term exit, and departure/non-payment is met with forfeiture rather than a true-up — walk-away territory.
- **Cure:** one inserted subparagraph 7.2A carrying exactly the three fallback elements (12-month commitment window, 30 days' notice reduction, true-up not penalty), drafted as a Teleglobe-only right so other Parties cannot reallocate their shares onto us; no neighbouring text rewritten.
